reviewTitle: Cute but cheap. Took forever to get them.
reviewDescription: It took nearly a month to get these. Tracking was garbage for a while. They didn't come in a box, they came bubble wrapped in a bag. Smelled heavily of glue or spray paint, thankfully the smell dissipated fast. Though looking them over there was something smudged on the side of one of them, no idea what, wiped off though. They fit well, and are TOASTY warm. The toe shape is kinda odd as it's a little square to me but it's ok. Definitely not non slip, kinds easy to slide around on these as there is really no grip. As I write this they're currently on sale for $34 which seems a much more reasonable price than what I paid for them. Wish I would have waited. Overall, I like them, but there's definitely also better made shoes out there for the same price. I think they're cute, but definitely cheap quality. I'll update how they last after some wear.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on March 22, 2024
